_README: 1) 'inject' maps a field name -> [node_id, input_key] in YOUR exported template.json.
Get node_ids: in ComfyUI, build/open your H3 workflow, Save (API Format) -> template.json,
then find the node whose input you want to set (its key is the string id in the JSON).
2) 'shots' is the work list; each shot's 'fields' are injected into a fresh copy of the template.
The controller ALSO overrides the output-prefix field (see 'prefix_field') to fanout_<id> so
outputs are named per-shot and resume works. Delete a shot's file in ./outputs to re-run it.
This example is H3 text/image-to-video per shot (like bear/cake). For R2V multi-reference,
add ref-image fields here and map them to your ReferenceToVideo node's image inputs.

fields.positive_prompt: A Formosan black bear walks through a misty mountain forest, cinematic wildlife documentary, dawn light.
Close-up of the black bear's face, dew on its fur, shallow depth of field.
The bear wades across a clear stream, water splashing, mossy rocks and ferns behind.
